order_note: No predecessor and no order on this engine. SQL 115 needs public.sync_provider_stakeholder_account(uuid) (restored from supabase migration 20260728110453, owned by checksops_admin), the tables payment_provider_accounts, payment_provider_methods, stakeholder_accounts, tenants and tenant_users with the columns the function uses. The function runs after every INSERT or UPDATE of payment_provider_accounts and payment_provider_methods (trg_sync_provider_stakeholder_acct, trg_sync_provider_stakeholder_bank) and keeps one provider_connected partner payout stakeholder per tenant for the tenant's latest receiving account. It assumed one payment account per tenant; a tenant with a Moov account in two environments (staging, 2026-10-25) got a second active partner payout insert, refused by stakeholder_accounts_one_partner_payout (23505), which rolled back moov-sync. SQL 115 replaces only that function (same signature and attributes): no insert when another active partner payout exists, and its own environment's row is re-activated only when no other active payout exists. EXECUTE is revoked from PUBLIC, anon, authenticated and service_role; the callers (trg_sync_provider_stakeholder_account() and add_partner_stakeholder_to_check(uuid, uuid)) are SECURITY DEFINER. Production tenants hold one payment account each, so their behaviour is unchanged; the apply keeps the function identical across environments. If the read-only inspect reports already_applied true nothing is applied. Production (2026-10-27): the read-only inspect of 2026-10-27 (SSM 2db258df-47a8-414b-b7c6-b9686768c5b9) found EXECUTE also for checksops, which SQL 115 does not revoke (precondition_failures [function_acl_replaceable]); SQL 119 (ops/production-sql-119-apply.md, applied in production 2026-10-27, one-shot run 924b34f9-4fc6-446f-9190-e4bd9529cac8) left the owner as the only grantee first, so SQL 115 runs immediately after SQL 119.
